title: Visual Studio Code – versions
summary: Visual Studio Code released numerous updates from April 2024 through September 2026, with emphasis on agent-based development, integrated browser tools, AI model flexibility, and enhanced developer productivity features. This helps teams stay current on available coding editor capabilities and AI-assisted development workflows.
key_points: Agent-first development became central with autonomous task completion, background agents, and multi-agent orchestration across local and cloud resources
Integrated browser tools allow agents to validate their own work by taking screenshots, clicking through pages, and testing web apps without leaving the editor
Support for multiple AI models and providers, including Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, and custom API keys with configurable thinking effort and token optimization
MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers enable extensible tool ecosystems for agents to access specialized capabilities and APIs
Developer experience improvements include quick chats, chat checkpoints, session memory, and streamlined multi-file editing across workspaces

quotes.text: Run agents inside your project's Dev Container on SSH, Tunnel, and WSL hosts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows agents can execute in containerized environments matching project dependencies, enabling consistent AI-assisted development

quotes.text: Agent HQ gives you one place to manage all your agents, letting Copilot and custom agents collaborate across tasks.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates centralized multi-agent orchestration for delegating and monitoring work across different AI providers and execution contexts

quotes.text: Let agents open pages, take screenshots, and click through to validate their own work, now generally available.
quotes.why_it_matters: Agents can autonomously test their code changes through browser automation, reducing human verification overhead
